title: Long run, peak-build dose

steps.target: Z1-Z2, HR cap 142, hike the steep climbs

coachNotes: Recalibrated: D+ drives duration, duration drives load. 1100m at your observed ~330m/h costs 3h25m, and 3h25m at honest Z2 costs 139, not 120. Vert trimmed from 1200m to keep the day under 3.5h. HR cap 142 is the whole plan: at HR 154 this same day costs 195 and the ramp breaks. Hike every steep climb to hold it. Descend deliberately, stop at any niggle.
